# Nutshell CRM | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| B2B small team sales management | The main link, “List or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - advance phase” - triggers the next step - manage the double drive, to verify whether B2B small team sales management really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. ### Scene 2: We got a deal. The main link, “List or interactive entry - formation of a customer and business - push phase” - triggers the next step - manage the double drive, to verify whether the number of customers on the site is actually reduced by manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Sold and mail marketing synergies | Using “lists or interactive entry - formation of customer and business opportunities - push phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - managing the double drive, verify whether the synergy between sales and mail marketing really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| CRM replacement without complex implementation | The main link, “List or interactive entry - formation of customer and business - push phase” - triggers the next step - manage the double drive, to verify whether the CRM replacement, which does not require complex implementation, really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
